capabilities.notes: The panel reads the Dex folder opened as the Obsidian vault.
This panel does not run Dex MCP tools or commands.
The panel does not load Dex slash commands or skills.
Obsidian does not run Dex lifecycle hooks.

Today's brief appears when the Dex folder is open and the panel is enabled. Under that brief, Decided lately shows recorded decisions from local files without typing. A topic ask can look for a specific decision.
The panel does not schedule jobs.
The panel has no command palette entries and does not ask for edits.
This is a local Obsidian plugin, not an Agent Plugins package.

limitations: A person still has to open the Dex folder in Obsidian and enable the local Dex panel. Ubuntu Cloud is not a person opening Obsidian.
The panel is read-only: it does not edit notes, run Dex commands, or use the internet.
This local plugin has not been submitted to the Obsidian community store.
VS Code and Kiro shared lot files are deferred. This lot does not add them.
This runner will not invent a ChatGPT Work folder grant.
name: Obsidian
summary: Local read-only Dex panel in Obsidian: today's brief, Decided lately, then a topic ask from your own files. No edits, no commands, no internet.
